court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Marin
case_search_note: ePortal (linked from marin.courts.ca.gov/online-services/ecourt-online-portal). Public users can search general case info and the court calendar (parties, list of filed documents, past and future hearings) but cannot view minute orders or documents online; parties/attorneys can request remote document access. A public kiosk in Room 113 shows documents for publicly available cases. The court page does not say explicitly whether criminal cases are included. Traffic/infractions have a separate site: https://apps.marin.courts.ca.gov/MarinTrafficWeb/TrafficMain.aspx

courthouses.name: Marin County Superior Court — Hall of Justice (Civic Center)
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m., closed 12–1 p.m. Clerk offices 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–4:00 p.m. Criminal phone line 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–2:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Court's only location; hears all case types including felony, misdemeanor and traffic. Criminal clerk: (415) 444-7070, criminal@marin.courts.ca.gov. Traffic: (415) 448-8230 per the Traffic Division page (Contact Us page lists (415) 444-7180 — conflicting). Room conflict: Criminal and Traffic listed in Room 113 on Contact Us/Criminal/Traffic pages but Room C-10 on the location page. Mailing: P.O. Box 4988, San Rafael, CA 94913. Legal Self-Help Center Room C-44, (415) 444-7130.
courthouses.todo: No official courtroom/department list found on the court site; confirm current Traffic phone (448-8230 vs 444-7180) and Criminal clerk room (113 vs C-10).

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: Post-plea program with intensive supervision and treatment for people with substance use disorders: regular court appearances, meetings with probation officer/case manager, drug testing; four phases, typically about 12 months. Contact Marin County Behavioral Health and Recovery Services.

programs.name: STAR (Mental Health) Court
programs.summary: Post-plea, court-supervised alternative to traditional probation for defendants with serious mental illness; links to treatment, housing, employment. Three phases of ~6 months each, averaging about 18 months.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: Post-plea program for military veterans facing criminal charges who have substance use disorder and/or serious mental illness; community treatment plus intensive supervision.

programs.name: Legal Self-Help Center
programs.summary: Room C-44, Hall of Justice. Help with forms for people without a lawyer. selfhelp@marin.courts.ca.gov.

jails.name: Marin County Jail
jails.phone_note: Jail info line per Sheriff FAQ (arrest, charges, bail). Sheriff's Contact page lists the jail at (415) 473-6655; Custody Division page lists housing sergeant (415) 499-7316. Prisoner Services (mental-illness visiting help): (415) 473-7268.
jails.note: County's only adult jail, on the Civic Center grounds. Houses men and women (no one under 18 except as required by law). Visits must be booked 24 hours ahead (no walk-ups): 1 onsite (30 min) + 1 video (25 min) per day, max 3 visitors. Deposits: AccessCorrections.com, phone 1-866-345-1884, lobby kiosk, or money order to 'Marin County Jail'. Commissary packages: https://www.marinpackages.com/. Court link: the Hall of Justice is the county's only courthouse.
jails.todo: Three different jail phone numbers on official Sheriff pages (473-7316, 473-6655, 499-7316) — confirm which is current.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — look up a bail agent's license status by name or number. Marin Sheriff: bail accepted 24 hours a day at the Marin County Jail for people in custody (or held elsewhere on a Marin warrant) — cash, postal/bank money order payable to the Clerk of the Court, or surety bond from a California-based company; credit-card cash advance via GovPay 888-604-7888 / govpaynet.com. Personal checks never accepted. Source for jail bail info: https://marinsheriff.gov/about-us/detention-bureau/custody-division
